# `/mfa` endpoints

Base URL: `https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com`

### GET /mfa/v1/okta-verify/config

`getMFAOktaConfigV1` — Configuration of okta mfa method

This API returns the configuration of an Okta MFA method.

- Scopes: idn:mfa-configuration:manage, idn:mfa-configuration:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Returns 200: mfaoktaconfig

### PUT /mfa/v1/okta-verify/config

`setMFAOktaConfigV1` — Set okta mfa configuration

This API sets the configuration of an Okta MFA method.

- Scopes: idn:mfa-configuration:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Body (application/json): mfaoktaconfig
- Returns 200: mfaoktaconfig

### GET /mfa/v1/duo-web/config

`getMFADuoConfigV1` — Configuration of duo mfa method

This API returns the configuration of an Duo MFA method.

- Scopes: idn:mfa-configuration:manage, idn:mfa-configuration:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Returns 200: mfaduoconfig

### PUT /mfa/v1/duo-web/config

`setMFADuoConfigV1` — Set duo mfa configuration

This API sets the configuration of an Duo MFA method.

- Scopes: idn:mfa-configuration:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Body (application/json): mfaduoconfig
- Returns 200: mfaduoconfig

### GET /mfa/v1/kba/config

`getMFAKbaConfigV1` — Configuration of kba mfa method

This API returns the KBA configuration for MFA.

- Scopes: idn:mfa-kba:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, USER
- Parameters:
  - `allLanguages` (query) — Indicator whether the question text should be returned in all configured languages * If true, the question text is returned in all languages that it is configured in. * If false, the question text…
- Returns 200: array of kbaquestion

### POST /mfa/v1/kba/config/answers

`setMFAKBAConfigV1` — Set mfa kba configuration

This API sets answers to challenge questions. Any configured questions omitted from the request are removed from user KBA configuration.

- Scopes: idn:mfa-kba:authenticate
- User levels: USER
- Body (application/json): array of kbaanswerrequestitem
- Returns 200: array of kbaanswerresponseitem

### GET /mfa/v1/{method}/test

`testMFAConfigV1` — Mfa method's test configuration

This API validates that the configuration is valid and will properly authenticate with the MFA provider identified by the method path parameter.

- Scopes: idn:mfa-configuration:manage, idn:mfa-configuration:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `method` (path, required) — one of okta-verify, duo-web — The name of the MFA method. The currently supported method names are 'okta-verify' and 'duo-web'.
- Returns 200: mfaconfigtestresponse
